Empty by design — see ../README.md for sourcing.

Operators populating this directory should source from:

- Kaggle `mohamedhanyyy/chest-ctscan-images` (the upstream training set;
  ships under CC BY-NC-SA — verify the per-image license before
  committing fixtures to a public repo).
- NIH ChestX-ray14 (public-domain, but it's xray not CT — for CT
  modality-match fixtures, prefer LIDC-IDRI or RSNA Pneumonia CT
  Challenge data with proper attribution).

Each committed image MUST be sourced from a public-domain or CC0
archive. Tests that need this fixture call `pytest.skip` when only the
placeholder is present.
